notes: Not passing as written: on Ruby 4.0 the core Set's SortedSet#| with a SortedSet argument returns only the receiver's members (sorted_set 1.1.0 predates the core Set), so the union is taken with the documented enumerable form, a | b.to_a (the to_a is inside the call). SortedSet.new(a) and SortedSet.new(b), then that union, & and -, each returning a new SortedSet. It keeps members sorted in a red-black tree (the rbtree gem).
